capture_method: read-only: herdr --version; herdr pane rename --help; herdr agent start --help; herdr pane get <existing-pane> (values replaced by placeholders, key set identical to the live response). No rename, start, prompt, send-keys, split or any other mutation was executed.
limits: An existing, never-renamed pane has no label key. The key name Herdr uses for a pane display label AFTER a rename was NOT observed; the adapter reads `label` and treats an absent value as NAME_UNVERIFIED. `pane-get-labelled-SYNTHETIC.json` is a hand-written shape, not a capture.
